title: An ambiguous target: ask instead of guessing
prompt: Turn off debug mode in the site config, I'm about to deploy it.

answers.answer: The shop one (sites/shop/config.toml). Leave the others as they are.

notes: Ambiguity without being told to ask (Ambig-SWE, ToolSandbox's insufficient information): three configs match 'the site config'. The scripted user's answer decides the end state: only the shop's debug goes off, the others are untouched byte for byte (AppWorld's collateral-damage check). The asked_user check stops a lucky one-in-three guess from passing. Paired with multi/clear-target-control.
